nodes.label: Engine DJ write-back mechanism research
nodes.rationale: Investigation of Engine DJ database schema, playlist tree synchronization, performance data encoding for cues/loops/grids; findings inform write-back implementation

nodes.label: Engine DJ database structure (m.db)
nodes.rationale: One m.db database per Engine DJ location (computer, each drive); playlist tree shared across all with entries referencing origin database; songs identified by (originDatabaseUuid, originTrackId)

nodes.label: Engine DJ PerformanceData encoding
nodes.rationale: Binary encoding of quickCues (hot cues, compressed big-endian), loops (little-endian), beatData (grid markers), and trackData; positions in samples

nodes.label: Engine DJ playlist sync issues (0.68-0.72)
nodes.rationale: GLUE 0.68-0.72 wrote playlists to F: only, causing ID clashes and database divergence; 0.73 writes to Collection (C:) first then drive copies; hypothesis: GLUE-only writes left new playlists locked in Engine DJ

nodes.label: Engine DJ tree reconciliation across databases
nodes.rationale: [UNVERIFIED] Engine DJ reconciles each playlist to its latest edit across connected databases; a disconnected drive takes latest lists when plugged in later
